items.html: *And now we shall explain these aspects, how they are made through Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin. And behold, at the beginning of the Ibur there was the coupling, and then the drop came out in the aspect of ten Malchuts that are in these ten Sefirot of the externality. And afterwards, in the Ibur, these ten external Sefirot were completed, all of which are only NHY alone, as mentioned. And this is in a general way, meaning that the NHY that are in each one of these nine Sefirot of the externality were completed.
